en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a wooden truss bridge over a river with a person and child standing by the water in the foreground. On the hill behind the bridge stands a tall church with a prominent spire surrounded by trees. Dark, dramatic storm clouds fill the sky. The caption in the lower left corner reads "GAUJ IENA Pirms nega i sa" (with some letters slightly unclear), printed directly on the image.
